name: schedule-management-system-root
description: Root package for running frontend and backend concurrently

scripts.start: concurrently --names "backend,frontend" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "backend,frontend" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
